action: Read When bills fall on Bills
user_goal: I want to see which days the bills land on
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Bills
Find the panel "When bills fall" above the list
Hover or focus Fri, Nov 27
expected: The panel shows the next 30 days as whole weeks from Sunday, today (Nov 14) marked, no sideways scroll and no overlap
Every item sits inside its cell in short words with no cut-off ellipsis; Nov 27 reads "Hikari Denki ¥11,220 · to check" and "Rent −¥82,000"

The line under it reads "¥207,780 goes out in the next 30 days and ¥300,000 comes in as clients pay as usual. The heaviest day is Fri, Nov 27 (¥82,000). If clients pay late you are short from Nov 27 to Nov 28."
The readout under the grid, for Nov 27, keeps the long words: "Hikari Denki ¥11,220 waits in To check and is not counted yet; Rent −¥82,000" and says short if clients pay late

action: Switch When bills fall between Chart and Table
user_goal: I want the days as a list
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Bills
In "When bills fall" press Table, then Chart
Reload
expected: Table has the columns Day, What, Goes out and Comes in, one row per day with something on it, in date order: Wed, Nov 18 CloudBox Plus −¥1,980 through Thu, Dec 10 Card B statement −¥61,000
The Fri, Nov 27 row carries the full words about Hikari Denki and "short if clients pay late", with ¥82,000 out
The choice is kept on this device after the reload (D59)

user_goal: I want to know what I really earn a month and which client pays late
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Clients
Read the panel "Money in" above the client list
Press How fast they pay, then By month
expected: The panel "Money in" sits above the list at 1440px with two questions: By month and How fast they pay, and Chart · Table
By month draws payments received month by month as columns split by client, with a legend naming Acme Corp, Northwind and Beacon Studio
How fast they pay draws one row per client with a dot for each paid invoice and the days it took; its Table twin lists the same days
Every figure in the line under the chart appears in the Table twin; nothing is cut off

action: Read a card's cycle on its panel
user_goal: I want to know when I pay for this card and from what
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Cards, then Card A
Read its cycle, then press Table
Open Card B
expected: Card A: the cycle has three tracks, This cycle (Building ¥28,450 to the close on Nov 30), You pay (¥58,000 due Nov 26, then ¥28,450) and Covered by (Cash on hand); the line reads "Card A closes Nov 30 and is paid Dec 26. The ¥58,000 statement paid Nov 26 is covered by cash on hand."

Card B: This cycle Building ¥61,000 to the close on Nov 15, You pay ¥61,000 due Dec 10, Covered by Northwind pays ¥120,000; the line reads "Card B closes Nov 15 and is paid Dec 10. The ¥61,000 statement paid Dec 10 is covered once Northwind pays."
The Table has the columns Day, What happens and Amount; labels do not overlap at 1440px

action: Read What you keep on Saving
user_goal: I want to see what I kept and how long my cash lasts
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Saving
Read the panel "What you keep"
Press each of Where each payment went, What you kept and How long it lasts, then Table where it is offered
expected: The heading stays "What you keep" for all three questions, with the switch captioned "Look at"

Where each payment went draws money in, what was set aside and what was spent as a flow; What you kept draws money in each month split into spent and kept; How long it lasts draws one bar of months against a month of spending with marks at 3 and 6 months
The figures in each line match its Table twin; one y-axis, no overlap, nothing clipped at 1440px

action: Pin a view from a page panel
user_goal: I want a page's picture on Home
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
Bills open
steps: In "When bills fall" press Pin to Home
Open Home
Do the same from Clients → Money in and Spending → Over time
expected: Pinning says it is pinned (on this device when the household keeps canvases here)
Home draws the picture with the same numbers and no model call; the pinned title is the panel's title
Unpinning removes it

action: Ask for a view and follow See it in
user_goal: I want the picture in Ask and then its page
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
A working model (the server's or the Codex bridge)
Ask open at /canvas
steps: Type "What's due, and when?" and press Enter
Press See it in Bills ›
Back in Ask type "Which client pays late?" and press Enter
Press See it in Clients ›
expected: The answer holds the same calendar as Bills → When bills fall, with the same line (¥207,780 goes out ... ¥300,000 comes in), and ends with See it in Bills ›, which opens /bills
The second answer draws the clients' pace picture and ends with See it in Clients ›, which opens /clients
No amount typed by the model appears in a block

action: Read Regular costs by month on Over time
user_goal: I want to see how much of each month is fixed
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Spending → Over time
Find the columns panel above the Regular costs list
Press Table, then Chart
expected: The panel "Regular costs by month" sits above the Regular costs list and is not the Month by month panel at the top; it draws four columns, August to November, each split into Regular costs and Everything else, with a legend of both
November reads (so far) with ¥99,480 regular of ¥152,230 and the line "November: ¥99,480 of ¥152,230 is regular costs (65%); the biggest is Rent (¥82,000)."

The Table has the head Month, Regular costs, Everything else, Total and the rows August ¥88,780 / ¥0 / ¥88,780, September ¥103,380 / ¥47,000 / ¥150,380, October ¥110,240 / ¥21,820 / ¥132,060, November ¥99,480 / ¥52,750 / ¥152,230
One y-axis, no overlap, nothing clipped; the list below is unchanged

action: Search Spending and read it by month
user_goal: I want to see a shop or a word across months
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Open Spending and search "food"
Read the panel "Month by month" above the month lists
Press Table, then Chart
expected: Three columns draw, September ¥5,960, October ¥11,440 and November ¥10,700 (current month marked), one colour per category the search found, no more than four, the rest as Other

The Table has the head Month, Food, Total with the same three rows; the summary line says "Food: ¥10,700 in November (3 items), ¥11,440 in October (3 items), ¥5,960 in September (1 item); nothing in the other 9 months. ¥28,100 in all."
The month-by-month lists with their items stay below, in the same order; "zzz" shows no chart, only "Nothing matches “zzz” in the last 12 months."

action: Read a pot's Its pace and Tax ahead
user_goal: I want to know if my pot is on pace and covers the tax
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px

On Saving add a pot "Trip to Osaka" with ¥15,000 saved, a target of ¥60,000 by 2027-03-31 and no fill rule; later a pot "Tax" with a fill rule and a Resident tax bill (Government & tax) due before its target
steps: Open Saving and find the pot's own panel
Read Its pace; on the Tax pot press Tax ahead, then Table
expected: A pot with a target and a date shows Its pace as one panel with no switch: a dotted line from ¥0 on the day it started to the target, the saved dot, and where the pot is expected by today; for the Osaka pot (started Nov 1) the line reads "By today: ¥5,200. ¥9,800 ahead of pace. At this pace: Dec 23, 2026. ¥11,250 a month to reach ¥60,000 by Mar 31."

A pot with a fill rule and a tax bill shows Tax ahead as a step line of what is in the pot against the tax bills due so far, with the bill's date marked; when it falls short the line says how much and on which day
A pot with both shows a "Look at" switch between Its pace and Tax ahead; a pot with neither has no panel; Pin to Home is on the panel

action: Ask what foreign payments cost by month
user_goal: I want my PayPal conversion cost month by month
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
A working model (the server's or the Codex bridge)
Ask open at /canvas
steps: Type "What have foreign payments cost me by month?" and press Enter
expected: The answer draws columns for June to November, each month's fees to receive and the conversion rate, with the line quoting ¥111,637 as the total (16 paid invoices; Acme Corp ¥52,545, Northwind ¥36,850, Beacon Studio ¥22,242 if asked per client)
There is no See it in button and no page has a panel for it (Ask only, D62); Pin to Home pins it to Home
No provider other than PayPal is named and the answer never says to leave PayPal; no amount typed by the model appears in the drawing

action: Read Who owes whom on People
user_goal: I want to see who has paid more of the shared costs
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
On Household → People add a person "Wife" with an equal share, and mark a bill or card charge Shared
steps: Open Household → People
Read the panel "Who owes whom" above the shares form
Press Table
expected: The panel draws a bar per person for what they paid of the shared costs with a tick for each fair share, a legend Paid / Fair share, and a line such as "Wife owes Ben ¥4,200." when Ben alone paid ¥8,400 of ¥8,400 shared

The Table has the head Person, Paid, Fair share, Balance and a Together row; before anything is shared the panel says "Nothing has been shared since the split began or was last settled. Mark a bill or a card charge as shared and it shows here."
With Ben alone the panel says "Add a person in Household → People to split shared costs."; Pin to Home is on the panel

action: Open the family link drawn through the views
user_goal: I want my wife's read-only page to look like the app
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
Wife added on Household → People and a live family link (Household → People → Make a link)
Private window, no household cookie
steps: Open the link
Press Table under Where this month goes, then Person
Read Who owes whom and Shared bills coming up
expected: The month panel is headed "Where this month goes" with a Look at it by switch (Category, Person) and Chart | Table; Who owes whom draws the same bars as on People
Shared bills coming up is a table with its line, no calendar picture
No Ask about this, no Pin to Home and no File on any panel, no sign-in prompt, no email and no PayPal word; nothing on the page changes data
A link that was stopped or never existed shows only "This link has ended."

action: See older pins and the what-if sliders with the step line
user_goal: I want my earlier pinned canvases to still draw
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
A canvas pinned before this build (a flow chart, a compare and a by-person block) on Home, or the starters on Ask → Canvases
steps: Open Home and read each pinned canvas
On the What if starter move the sliders (amount, late client) and press the scenario's change
expected: The older flow chart draws as the forecast's step line, with the same low point as before, and when the scenario has a change a lighter ghost line shows the unchanged forecast behind it with a legend of both
The compare block draws two segments per row and the by-person block a segment per person, each with its Table twin and the same totals as before
The sliders redraw the line to the engine's late case without a model call; no overlap, no clipping, one y-axis
